comparator.name: Pharmacy
comparator.sourceNotes: The Pharmacy major combines a shared first year, a second year of pharmaceutical science, and advanced study of medicines and pharmaceutical practice. It includes a 15 EC research project and 15 EC of restricted Pharmacy electives. Teaching includes both English- and Dutch-language courses.

alternatives.distinctnessRationale: The options differ by 12 courses and 90 EC each way. The biomedical option emphasises cell biology, biochemistry, laboratory work, immunity and quantitative modelling. The medicine-use option emphasises psychology, qualitative inquiry, communication and public economics.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic bachelor Pharmacy. The 2026-2027 TER offers Major Pharmacy and Major Medical Pharmaceutical Sciences. Major Pharmacy is the eponymous route, contains the programme's full compulsory pharmaceutical-care and drug-science sequence, and is the route that directly reflects the target's broad professional and scientific identity. It is therefore selected independently of UCR fit; the alternative MPS major is a research-oriented route with a 30-EC free minor.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Two complete related-fields programmes are defensible: one centred on molecular disease, pharmacology and biomedical evidence, and one centred on medicine use, health behaviour and patient context. The next generator-backed direction is drug discovery, chemistry and formulation; UCR cannot implement it, so production stops at two and preserves the specialist and professional gaps explicitly.

notes.text: The Groningen major combines drug science with pharmaceutical care and professional practice. The UCR options explore biomedical drug mechanisms or the social and behavioural context of medicine use.

UCR Pharmacology introduces drug action and pharmacokinetics. The UCR options lack Groningen’s specialist courses in drug formulation, pharmaceutical analysis and medicinal chemistry, as well as its training in pharmacy practice.

audience.programmeDescription: Pharmacy at Groningen studies how medicines are developed, how they act in the body and how they are used in patient care. The comparison follows the Pharmacy major.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR options focus on the biology of drug action or on how people and health systems make treatment decisions. Groningen also teaches the preparation and analysis of medicines and pharmaceutical care.
